transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes it happens in the bathroom at work, or right when I get home. I hate saying it, but it’s started to feel like the only way I can calm down.
Do you worry about gaining weight?
Yes. A lot. If the scale goes up even a little, I panic. Or if my waistband feels tight under my work apron, it feels like I’ve ruined everything, like I’m going to be fat by the end of the day.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like more than you would normally eat?

Yes. When it happens, I can eat a lot really fast. Like a whole bag of chips, some pastries from the corner store, leftovers, and sweet drinks all in one sitting. Sometimes I don’t even realize how much is gone until after.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time happen?

For months now, it’s been most weeks. Usually at least a couple times a week I’ll eat way more than I meant to, and then I try to make up for it by throwing up, or not eating, or trying to exercise it off.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

It happens a lot. Sometimes right after I eat, I’ll go make myself throw up—at work in the bathroom if I’m there, or as soon as I get home. It’s gotten to where it feels like the only way I can calm down after eating, and I hate that.
Do you feel like you have control over what you're eating and how much you're eating during those times when you eat a lot really fast?

No, not really. Once I start, it feels like my hands just keep grabbing more food even though I’m telling myself to stop. It’s like I’m watching myself do it, but I can’t make myself quit in that moment.
Do you think your weight or shape is different from how others see you?

Yeah… I think so. Other people might say I look normal or fine, but I don’t see that. I can be having a good day at the shop, doing my work, and then I catch my reflection in the glass and all I can see is my stomach or my hips looking big. Then I just feel like a failure.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

Yes. Sometimes I don’t throw up after, but I still eat a lot really fast. Like I can go through a whole bag of chips, pastries from the corner store, leftovers, and sweet drinks all in one sitting before I even realize how much I ate.
Do you make yourself throw up after every time you eat a large amount of food in a short period?

Not every single time, no. But a lot of the time I do make myself throw up after I eat like that. Sometimes it’s at work in the bathroom, or as soon as I get home. I hate saying it, but it’s started to feel like the only thing that calms me down after.
Do you make yourself throw up after most of the times you eat a large amount of food in a short period?

Yeah… most of the time, I do. If I eat a lot like that, I usually end up making myself throw up, either in the bathroom at work or when I get home. I hate it, but it feels like the only way I can calm down after.
Do you make yourself throw up after almost every time you eat a large amount of food in a short period?

Yeah… almost every time now. If I eat a lot in a short time, I usually end up making myself throw up, either at work in the bathroom or right when I get home. I hate that it feels like the only way I can calm down after.
Do you make yourself throw up after eating normal meals, not just after eating a large amount of food?

Yes… it’s not only when I eat a huge amount. Sometimes even after a normal meal, I still make myself throw up. It might be in the bathroom at work or right when I get home. I hate it, but it’s started feeling like the only thing that settles me down.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal, not after binge eating?

It happens pretty often… not every single normal meal, but enough that it’s become a pattern. I’ll eat, and then I start feeling panicky or uncomfortable, and I end up making myself throw up—sometimes at work in the bathroom, or as soon as I get home. I hate that it feels like the only way I can calm down.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal?

It’s happening a lot… after I eat, even if it’s just a regular meal, I’ll start feeling like I can’t calm down unless I make myself throw up. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or I wait until I get home. I hate that it’s gotten to that point.
Is making yourself throw up after a normal meal as frequent as after eating a large amount of food in a short time?

It’s not just after I eat a lot. I do it after regular meals too… sometimes at work in the bathroom, or when I get home. I don’t know if it’s exactly as often, but it happens enough that it feels like that’s the only way I can calm myself down.
Is making yourself throw up after a normal meal happening as often as it does after you eat a large amount of food in a short time?

Yeah… it’s not only when I eat a lot fast. It happens after regular meals too, sometimes in the bathroom at work or right when I get home. I don’t know if it’s exactly the same amount, but it’s often enough that it feels like the only way I can calm down.
Is making yourself throw up after eating a normal meal happening more often, less often, or about the same as after you eat a large amount of food in a short time?

I think it’s about the same, honestly. It happens after regular meals too, not just when I eat a lot fast. I’ll end up doing it at work in the bathroom or right when I get home, and it’s like… I hate saying it, but it feels like the only way I can calm down.
Is making yourself throw up after eating a normal meal happening more often than after binge eating?

I don’t think it’s more often. It happens after both. Even after a normal meal, I’ll make myself throw up, like in the bathroom at work or when I get home. It’s gotten to where that feels like the only way I can calm down.
Is making yourself throw up after eating a normal meal happening less often than after you eat a large amount of food in a short time?

No, I wouldn’t say it’s less often. It’s happening after normal meals too. I keep making myself throw up after I eat, sometimes at work or right when I get home, and… I hate it, but it feels like the only thing that calms me down.
